description: Use before writing, reviewing, or debugging any code that uses a specific ML model (DINOv3, SAM 2, Whisper, Qwen3-Embedding, SigLIP 2…), whenever a model-provenance archive for it exists locally. Loads that archive's real source — checkpoint ids, API signatures, preprocessing constants, training recipe — so the code is written from the model's actual code instead of training-time recall, then mechanically checks the result. Triggers include "load DINOv3 and extract features", "fine-tune SAM 2 on my data", "why does this checkpoint 404", "review this inference script", or any coding task naming a model that has been harvested.
